findings.text: follow-on: launch_env now sets RECKON_SHIM_PYTHON unconditionally, so the shim's fallback interpreter resolution (repo .venv, then python3.12, then python3 at reckon/host_shims/srun:21-31) is no longer exercised by any test in this file and a regression in that order would not redden here.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest names neither baseline_suite nor after_suite, so review.py's annotate_review_of_run reports the added-failure count unmeasured even though both arms exist on disk (negative-control.log and gate-unprovisioned.log, named only under test_logs at manifest.md:15), so the review done-when's stated derivation by those field names cannot be satisfied for an implement-shaped run.
follow-on: the new fragment has no trailing newline, so git reports "\ No newline at end of file" on the added file.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 7dde3c88b; fb3fe7873 changes two interpreter references and adds RECKON_SHIM_PYTHON in launch_env, and 6d8c4f3a9 adds the 12-line evidence fragment; no product source changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: the gate is the unprovisioned extraction the done-when names (gate-unprovisioned.log: 11 passed, EXIT=0) against the parent's red arm (negative-control.log: 10 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1); I re-ran both arms from fresh git-archive extractions and got identical figures, so the measure is asserted and recorded.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the nested-launch tests pass in a git-archive extraction with no .venv; tests/test_nested_launch.py:24 takes the shim interpreter from sys.executable and tests/test_nested_launch.py:163 hands it to the shim as RECKON_SHIM_PYTHON, and I reproduced 11 passed / EXIT=0 in a fresh unprovisioned extraction of the reviewed head 6d8c4f3a9.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits [fb3fe7873, 6d8c4f3a9], arms recorded; its baseline_suite and after_suite fields are empty, so review.py's own read-time derivation reports the added-failure count unmeasured even though both arms exist under test_logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's three declared paths (tests/test_nested_launch.py, the evidence fragment, and an unused figure path); the diff touches only the test file and the fragment, both inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: the change adds no assertion, and a revert to the repo .venv interpreter reddens only under the unprovisioned measurement, not the routine provisioned suite; launch_env:163 now sets RECKON_SHIM_PYTHON for every launch so no test exercises the shim's fallback interpreter order (reckon/host_shims/srun:21).
justifications.evidence: the gate is exactly the unprovisioned extraction the done-when names and its log header records revision, module.__file__ and cwd, and I reproduced both arms independently.
justifications.fit: names follow mechanism and both commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no AI-attribution trailer, but the new fragment is written with no trailing newline.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_nested_launch.py:24 and :163 remove the file's dependence on a repository .venv, and a fresh unprovisioned extraction of head 6d8c4f3a9 passes 11/11 (review-head-arm.log).
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only tests/test_nested_launch.py and docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/the-nested-launch-tests-run-in-an-unprovisioned-tree.html, both inside the declared write paths.
